name: NOW ON SALE! ~Kanbai Orei! Depart Hen~
original_name: NOW ON SALE! 〜感売御礼! デパート編〜
source:
Main character is being persistently recommended to buy goods by a cute department store selling girl. The reason is harsh selling norms demanded from workers. Hero does not have money, but agrees to use credit card to help the girl. She is so grateful that spends evening with him. Investigation of these strange norms brings hero to the truth that girls are being insulted there every night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被一位可爱的百货商店销售女孩坚持推荐购买商品。原因是工人要求严格的销售规范。英雄没有钱，但同意用信用卡来帮助女孩。她非常感激与他共度夜晚。对这些奇怪规范的调查使英雄了解到女孩每天晚上都在那里受到侮辱的事实。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
